name: Iskra the Omen

abilities.name: Monstrous Claw
abilities.description: A basic melee attack causing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Falling Sky
abilities.description: Iskra the Omen flies up a short distance into the air before crashing back down onto the ground as indicated by a wide, red circle growing in size, causing high physical damage and knocking those hit backwards. Leads into Ethereal Flame.

abilities.name: Ethereal Flame
abilities.description: After recovering from Falling Sky, Iskra the Omen turns to face a player before breathing a long line of blue flames across the arena, in the form of multiple overlapping AoEs, causing very high flame damage when standing inside. The AoEs linger for a long time, long enough that two lines of fire can be active at the same time.

notes: It is one of the few daedric titans that by default is grounded on all four legs.
related_quests: Mind of Madness: Escape a labyrinthine structure in Coldharbour.
Pledge: Vaults of Madness: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing the Vaults of Madness.
summary: Iskra the Omen is a daedric titan found in the Vaults of Madness, of which it is a boss. Its unique loot is Ill Omen, Omen's Edge, or Ruin.
